# SINMOS TECHNOLOGY — Professional Trail Camera Manufacturer

> SHENZHEN SINMOS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD (SINMOS) is a professional trail camera (hunting camera) manufacturer founded in 2015, headquartered in Shenzhen, China. Arvelix Vision is its global export brand; arvelixvision.com is the official product showcase and inquiry portal. The company designs and manufactures high-performance trail cameras (4K/8K, 4G LTE, solar, WiFi) for distributors, brand owners, importers, and outdoor retailers. All products are CE, FCC, and RoHS certified. OEM & ODM services include logo printing, custom packaging, firmware customization, and private label manufacturing from 100 pcs.

Last updated: 2026-11-24

## Key Products (12 Trail Camera Models)

- PR1600 — WiFi 4K trail camera: 60MP max photo, 4K/1080P/720P video, 46× 940nm no-glow infrared, 0.3s trigger, 120° detection angle, up to 20m detection, WiFi + TrailCamGo app (iOS/Android), 20m WiFi range, 8×AA (up to 6 months), TF card up to 128GB, IP65, 430g.
- PR8000 — 8K WiFi trail camera: 60MP photo, 8K/4K/1080P video, 4pc 850nm infrared up to 20m, 0.3s trigger, 120° detection, up to 20m, WiFi + app, 20m WiFi range, 8×AA (up to 6 months), TF up to 128GB, IP65, 490g.
- PR801LTE — 8K 4G LTE trail camera: 60MP photo, 8K/4K/1080P video, 4pc 850nm infrared up to 20m, 0.3s trigger, 120°, up to 20m, 4G LTE (EU bands B1/B3/B7/B8/B20; US bands B2/B4/B5/B12/B13/B66/B71), 8×AA (up to 6 months), TF up to 128GB, IP66, 470g.
- PR903G — Solar 4G LTE trail camera: 60MP photo, 5K/4K/1080P video, 2pc 850nm infrared up to 20m, 0.3s trigger, 120°, up to 20m, 4G LTE (EU/US band options), 5200mAh battery + solar panel + extra 8×AA, TF up to 128GB, IP65, 650g.
- PR802LTE — 4G LTE trail camera: 60MP photo, 4K/2.7K/1080P video, 2pc 850nm infrared up to 20m, 0.3s trigger, 120°, up to 20m, 4G LTE (EU/US band options), 8×AA (up to 6 months), TF up to 128GB, IP65, 495g.
- H2G — Solar 4G trail camera: 60MP photo, 8K/4K/1080P video, 2pc 850nm infrared up to 20m, 0.3s trigger, 120°, up to 20m, 4G LTE (EU band B1/B3/B7/B8/B20), 7800mAh built-in battery + solar panel, TF up to 128GB, IP65, 905g.
- DL001 — Entry-level trail camera: 12MP photo, 1080P video, 940nm infrared lamp, 0.8s trigger, 100°, up to 10m, 8×AA (up to 6 months), TF up to 32GB, IP54, 405g.
- PR903DW — Solar WiFi trail camera: 60MP photo, 4K/2.7K/1080P video, 850nm infrared up to 20m, 0.3s trigger, 120°, up to 20m, WiFi + app, 20m WiFi range, 5200mAh battery + solar panel + extra 8×AA, TF up to 128GB, IP65, 400g.
- PR700 — 2.7K trail camera: 58MP photo, 2.7K video, 46× 940nm no-glow infrared, 0.3s trigger, 120°, up to 20m, 8×AA (up to 6 months), TF up to 128GB, IP65, 430g.
- PR1200 — 1080P trail camera: 36MP photo, 1080P video, 34× 940nm no-glow infrared, 0.6s trigger, 100°, up to 15m, 8×AA (up to 6 months), TF up to 64GB, IP54, 430g.
- H1W — Solar WiFi 8K trail camera: 60MP photo, 8K/4K/1080P video, 2pc 850nm infrared up to 20m, 0.3s trigger, 120°, up to 20m, WiFi + app, 20m WiFi range, 7800mAh built-in + solar panel + extra 8×AA, TF up to 128GB, IP65, 905g.
- PR800 — Scouting trail camera: 58MP photo, 2.7K video, 46× 940nm no-glow infrared, 0.3s trigger, 120° detection, up to 20m, IP65.

## FAQ
- What is your MOQ? Stock models: 1 pc. OEM/ODM orders: from 100 pcs.
- Do you support OEM/ODM? Yes. Logo printing, custom packaging, firmware customization, private label manufacturing.
- What certifications? CE, FCC, RoHS — compliant for European and North American markets.
- Delivery time? Stock: 3-7 days. OEM: 15-25 days depending on customization.
- Can I test samples? Yes, sample orders welcome (MOQ 1 pc); sample cost deducted from first bulk order.
- Quality assurance? 100% inspection — sensor calibration, trigger speed test, waterproof seal check, 24-hour aging test.
